note: Corps of Engineers campground in mature hardwoods on a bluff above the Cumberland River tailwater, just below Wolf Creek Dam and next to the Wolf Creek National Fish Hatchery. Two loops: the main loop near the hatchery and boat ramp, and the Annex about half a kilometre north. The river is stocked with trout. --Claude

flags: WATERFRONT riverview CONFIRMED (not riverfront): the river here is ~100 m wide, so the river values apply. The closest sites sit on the bluff edge in tree cover: 047 (36.875409,-85.149871) and 045 (36.875004,-85.149753) are 14 m above the tailwater (169.7 m at the lidar flight) with the water ~36-40 m away down a ~30-degree wooded bank; 043 (tent, 36.874522,-85.149609) 11 m above at 32 m; 050 (36.875876,-85.149784) 14 m above at 48 m; 054 (36.876711,-85.149785) 12.6 m above at 44 m; 030 (36.873358,-85.148994) 11.7 m above at 56 m; Annex 078 (36.878277,-85.148975) 12 m above at 68 m. rec.gov: 'The campground overlooks the river'. Too high and steep for the kayak test; the view is through trees from the bluff-edge sites (045-054).
